notes.title: “The pillar and foundation of the truth”
notes.intro: Paul calls the church of the living God the pillar and foundation of the truth.

views.label: The Church teaches with authority
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see the Church as entrusted with guarding and teaching the truth authoritatively.

views.label: The church upholds the truth of Scripture
views.summary: Protestants read the church as supporting and proclaiming the truth, which Scripture defines.
